scope: H-WP-04 Needle boundary overlay for H1 reference harness

NeedleIngressPreflight.law: Unresolved context, retrieval failure, empty selected toolset or incomplete encoder-budget fit blocks Needle and requires fallback.

NeedleRuntimeIdentity.law: Display name alone is never sufficient provenance; executable Needle identity is hash-bound.

laws: every effect requires an independent authority/effect gate

ClayIngressEnvelope.law: Only validated, provenance-bound Needle proposal data crosses the foreign-to-Clay semantic boundary.

known_counterexamples: ordinary parameters.properties is misread by upstream constrained.py unless normalized
constraint activation uses compact exact markers and has fail-open states
invalid-JSON restore fallback can mutate alias words inside values

CACTUS_CPP.wire_contract: canonical compact OpenAI-style tool JSON transformed by current Cactus into Needle-flat map
known_counterexamples: Needle constraint activation retains compact exact-marker weakness
syntax sanitizer does not establish offered-tool membership/required-key/duplicate-key safety
Tool RAG failure can return all tools
BM25 lexical tokenizer is byte/ASCII oriented for German UTF-8

hard_invariants: Needle is the sole intentional non-Clay semantic subsystem but never execution authority
Needle is a single-shot tool reflex, not dialogue memory or multi-step planner
context-dependent/deictic intent must be externally resolved or sent to the 4B fallback path
normal ingress never silently bypasses the Needle boundary contract
all selected tools must fit completely before inference; blind truncation is inadmissible
runtime/tool/alias/checkpoint/tokenizer identities are provenance-bound and collision checked
strict post-validation is mandatory even when constrained decoding is enabled
no-tool and invalid/ambiguous output never terminate the user turn silently; they trigger fallback
accepted route proposals remain non-authoritative until the separate effect gate
open_release_dependencies: mount official tokenizer/needle.model and an official pinned checkpoint/runtime artifact
exact Needle-tokenizer measurement of current German query + catalogue distributions
official-checkpoint zero-shot German routing and argument evaluation
retrieval recall@k/downstream differential if retrieval remains candidate
JAX/Cactus/ONNX differential where exact runtime artifacts are available
target Ubuntu reference-harness replay and recovery testing
